intro: Malaysia seized a $12.2 million shipment of U.S.-origin AI chips suspected of violating export controls, enforcing permit requirements it introduced last year to prevent rerouting to China. Google released Gemini 4 Carbon, its latest frontier model offering improvements in coding, agentic tasks, and cybersecurity, though availability remains limited. The Justice Department is scrutinizing Nvidia's $12.9 billion acquisition of Hugging Face, while SpaceX AI faces substantial daily fines over unpermitted data center construction in Mississippi.
